draw: numpy.random.default_rng(seed).choice over the sorted eligible asset_ids, without replacement; written sorted by asset_id
dedupe: one row per asset_id: the smallest (source, relpath) among its eligible paths

eligibility.unrenderable: ext has a derive decoder and src_kind in ['heif', 'jpeg', 'png', 'psd', 'raw', 'tiff', 'webp']
eligibility.not_owner_source: the source's person is 'owner' (others' photos are never drawn)
eligibility.base_set: asset_id is not in the base set
eligibility.never_send: not on evals/never-send.txt (asset_id or path glob, shoebox.privacy parsing)
eligibility.target_group: not in a frame capture group (group_id) that holds a target
eligibility.never_send_group: not in a frame capture group that holds a never-send path
